minutes.headline: ZBA ruled both Whalum Road apartment changes minor, then continued the Gilchrist Street land-swap hearing to July 25.
minutes.summary: The board met on proposed changes to the Whalum Road 40B apartment project: a parking layout realignment and a new maintenance garage. Both were treated as minor changes within the building inspector's scope. The second hearing, a special permit for a Gilchrist Street land swap with the town, was continued to July 25 because only four members were seated and a supermajority was needed. Materials were read and neighbors and conservation members commented.

public_comment.topic: Supports the land swap as protecting land and trail access.
Concerns about seven driveways, clear-cutting along the 15-foot strip, and possible ATV and snowmobile use and parking.
Questions seven houses and why a second easement is needed beside her driveway easement.
Strongly in favor; the choice is five or seven houses; ATVs not allowed on the trail.
Worries about construction disruption, clear-cutting, and use of the 15-foot strip; wants clarity at the next hearing.
No designated parking; foot and bicycle traffic only on the easement.

votes.motion: Consider the parking reconfiguration a minor change to the comprehensive permit and allow it.
Allow the applicant to build the maintenance garage as a minor change.
Continue the Gilchrist Street hearing to July 25.

decisions.decision: Parking realignment declared a minor change, within the building inspector's scope.
Maintenance garage also placed within the building inspector's scope.
Gilchrist Street special permit hearing continued for two weeks so a full five-member board can sit.
Continued hearing set for July 25 at seven o'clock, with public comment after the presentation.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals continued the Gilchrist Street land-swap special permit hearing to July 25 at seven o'clock.
The continuance was sought because only four members were seated and a supermajority was needed, so a full five-member board can sit.
The board treated the Whalum Road 40B parking realignment as a minor change within the building inspector's scope.
The board also placed the proposed maintenance garage at the Whalum Road project within the building inspector's scope as a minor change.
Residents spoke on the land swap, raising driveways, clear-cutting along the 15-foot strip, and ATV use and parking, while others supported it.

why_it_matters: The Gilchrist Street land swap with the town is undecided, so neighbors' concerns about driveways, tree clearing and trail access have not yet been ruled on.
Treating the Whalum Road changes as minor means they go to the building inspector instead of a new public hearing on the comprehensive permit.
